title: GM brings back Apple CarPlay as buyers demand it
title_zh: GM brings back Apple CarPlay as buyers demand it
summary: GM is bringing Apple CarPlay and Android Auto back to its vehicles, reversing one of the more unpopular decisions in the automaker's recent history.
